sql: SELECT y.trip_date, MAX(CASE WHEN y.trip_date = DATE '2024-12-21' THEN y.trips END) AS target_trips, AVG(CASE WHEN y.trip_date <> DATE '2024-12-21' THEN y.trips END) AS baseline_avg_trips FROM whybot.yellow_daily y JOIN TPCDS_DB.date_dim d ON d.d_date = y.trip_date WHERE d.d_dow = 6 AND y.trip_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-12-01' AND DATE '2024-12-31' GROUP BY y.trip_date ORDER BY y.trip_date LIMIT 500
